answer: To resist Sybil swarms, nodes verify cryptographic attestation chains and zero-knowledge proofs before granting market access. Each identity mints a verifiable credential anchored like a marble foundation. Sybil clusters seeking network influence face exponential capital exhaustion, as entry staking scales superlinearly with cluster density. A valid proof acts as a lantern exposing coordinated replicas, forcing attacker funds to drain into an unrecoverable protocol lagoon.
